versions.changelog: La skill puente ahora se llama f100k-puente

Initial release — multiplies a script or idea into up to 5 tailored content formats.

- Transforms a single core script into 5 ready-to-film proposals, each with a different angle and format.
- Adapts all examples, language, and comparisons to the user’s specific field (not just marketing/online business).
- Guides through script extraction, element breakdown, strategic format selection, and clear output for each proposal.
- Ensures a mix of formats (low/medium production, narrative/data-driven) that maximize content output and audience reach.
- Includes a concise, actionable closing prompt to generate a full script from any chosen proposal.
